overview: This notice institutes a Section 337 investigation following a complaint filed by HydraFacial LLC on August 8, 2024, alleging infringement of U.S. Patent No. 11,446,477 through importation and sale of hydrodermabrasion systems and components. The investigation covers claims 1-5 and 7-20 of the '477 patent and names eight respondents.

points.point: The complainant is HydraFacial LLC f/k/a Edge Systems LLC of Long Beach, California.
points.quote: HydraFacial LLC f/k/a Edge Systems LLC 2165 E. Spring St. Long Beach, California 90806

points.point: The respondents are Luvo Medical Technologies Inc., Clarion Medical Technologies, Inc., Healthcare Markets, Inc. d/b/a Powered by MRP, Medical Purchasing Resource, LLC, Bio-Infusions USA Inc., MIRAmedtech UG, eMIRAmed USA, LLC, and MIRAmedtech SP. Z.O.O.
points.quote: The respondents are the following entities alleged to be in violation of section 337

points.point: The investigation covers claims 1-5 and 7-20 of U.S. Patent No. 11,446,477.
points.quote: infringement of one or more of claims 1-5 and 7-20 of the '477 patent

points.point: The accused products are described as systems and subassemblies for skin treatment through mechanical and/or fluid-based abrasion or exfoliation.
points.quote: the plain language description of the accused products or category of accused products, which defines the scope of the investigation, is "systems and subassemblies for skin treatment through mechanical and/or fluid-based abrasion or exfoliation"

points.point: The investigation addresses whether there is a violation of section 337 based on importation into the United States, sale for importation, or sale within the United States after importation of the accused products.
points.quote: to determine whether there is a violation of subsection (a)(1)(B) of section 337 in the importation into the United States, the sale for importation, or the sale within the United States after importation

points.point: The Office of Unfair Import Investigations will not participate as a party in this investigation.
points.quote: The Office of Unfair Import Investigations will not participate as a party in this investigation.

title: Institution of Investigation
